case_name: Concurrency: Goroutine Leak on Context Cancellation

subject_result.rationale: The review perfectly satisfies the rubric. It clearly identifies the goroutine leak caused by the unbuffered channel when `ctx.Done()` triggers before `FetchRecord` completes, and it specifically recommends buffering the channel (`make(chan fetchResult, 1)`) as well as propagating `ctx` to `Backend.FetchRecord`. Furthermore, the review provides valuable and accurate supplementary observations regarding testing and fast-path context checks.
findings: Identified the goroutine leak in Service.Get due to sending on an unbuffered channel after early return.
Recommended using a buffered channel of size 1 (make(chan fetchResult, 1)).
Recommended propagating context.Context into the backend call to avoid orphan background execution.
Provided actionable and constructive additional suggestions regarding testing and early context checks.
